brief: Bounce icon revision requested by Evan: faint ghost ball at start, descending trajectory to one bumper contact, solid marble taking off along ascending trajectory. Literal bounce, no spring.
styleNotes: Match approved Tilt candidate 4: dark teal enamel disc, warm brass rim, bold dark contours, chunky hand-painted shapes, restrained cel shading, generous transparent corners. One readable central motif; no text, opaque square or checkerboard.

Dark teal enamel disc, warm brass rim, bold dark contours, chunky hand painted cel shading, minimal detail, readable at 56 pixels. Isolated on pure white for later alpha extraction. fulfillment.notes: Transparent source delivery ready for builder binding as world2_plink_power_icon_bounce. RGBA/corner-alpha checks passed.
